name: memory-guard
description: Keeps typecheck, build, test and Playwright below the group memory max: runs them with a single process, waits or refuses, and retries a command that died with exit 137

margin.title: Margin
margin.description: Percentage of each group's memory max that stays free. The high mark counts only for a group with no max

waitSeconds.title: Wait
waitSeconds.description: Seconds a heavy command waits for memory to drop before it is refused
